news.headline: China, U.S. discuss tariff cuts ahead of Trump-Xi meeting next week
news.summary: Investing.com -- China and the United States discussed tariff reductions and agricultural trade during their first trade council meeting on Friday, as both countries seek progress on a proposed $60 billion tariff-cutting agreement ahead of talks between Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping.

news.headline: Tariffs Pushed Prices Up. Why Retail and Industrial Investors Shouldn't Expect a Quick Reversal
news.summary: Tariffs are a moving target, and rising costs tend to be sticky, which is bad news for companies and retail customers.

news.headline: Kevin Simpson Is Buying More Caterpillar as an AI Trade That Isn’t Just AI
news.summary: A heavy-equipment maker has lost nearly half its value from its peak, yet one CNBC trader keeps buying. His case rests on data center power and two other businesses, but the same AI swings that built the rally could still deepen the slide.

news.headline: What Is Caterpillar (CAT) Signaling With Its Biggest Underground Mining Machine Yet?
news.summary: Caterpillar (NYSE:CAT) has introduced the CAT R3200 XE LHD, its largest underground diesel-electric mining machine to date. The new loader combines diesel-electric power with advanced autonomous and semi-autonomous capabilities for underground mining operations. Caterpillar is positioning the R3200 XE LHD to improve throughput and fuel efficiency for mining customers using digital control systems.

news.headline: Weekly Gains Hold Up Despite a Friday Slide as Chips Lead and Yields Climb
